# Feature: Runner Quick Scan

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #18 -->

## Intent
Time to first value (FR-008, SCN-004). The runner orchestrates prepare, warm-up, measure × N, analyze, report, abort, and writes the artifact. Quick Scan is smoke, not representative gameplay (RISK-002).

Roadmap: Epic 2 Web CLI.

## Preconditions
- Scenario engine (#15), collectors (#16), rule engine (#7), report (#17), init/config (#13)

## Happy Path
- [ ] `potato run` Quick Scan walks visible phases including three measure repetitions, or fails with a clear phase status
- [ ] On success a schema-valid run artifact is in the artifact store
- [ ] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Warm-up crash → `failed` + error, not a budget/performance fail (EDGE-006)
- [ ] Abort → `cancelled`, not baseline-eligible; launched children are killed (NFR-007)
- [ ] Launch uses argv arrays only (no shell string)

## Regression
- [ ] Missing required doctor capability still exits 3
- [ ] `pnpm checks` does not require Playwright browser download
- [ ] Scope: `packages/core/src/runner/**`, `packages/cli/**`, `packages/adapter-web/**` launch helper if needed — no dashboard

## Assumptions
- Collect/driver/launcher are injectable for unit tests
- Smoke driver emits `frame_time` samples so a completed artifact does not need a live CDP session
- Live Playwright page driving is follow-up; this slice proves orchestration + artifact

## Security Coverage
- B-04: spawn argv array, `shell: false`
- F-03: no secrets in artifacts
- P-02: errors are message/code only
- P-04: artifact writes stay under `.potato/` via existing store

## Implementation Notes
- `packages/core/src/runner`: Quick Scan with 3 measure reps, argv launcher (`shell: false`), abort kills children.
- Smoke driver emits `frame_time` samples so a completed artifact does not need live CDP.
- Warm-up throw → `failed`, not budget fail. Abort → `cancelled`.
- CLI `potato run` prints phases and writes a schema-valid artifact via the store.
- 85 tests; `pnpm checks` green without Playwright download.
